title: The finite etale trace has locally free integral image
statement: Let E be a finite normed extension of Q_l, X a scheme, and P a locally free finite-rank module over the continuous E coefficients on X. For a finite etale surjection p:U→X, a locally free integral module M on U and an isomorphism E_U⊗M≅p*P, there exists an epimorphism τ:p_*p*P→P such that the categorical image of p_*M→Res(P), using the pushed embedding and τ, is locally free over the continuous integral coefficients on X. No rationalization of the image inclusion, Noetherianity, or stratification is asserted. Coefficients and internal modules are those of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]; the pushed embedding is that of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-lattice-intersection].

source.place: Pushing down by the trace: sheet-sum trace and local freeness of its integral image

proof.text: Obtain the epic normalized internal trace from [lem-sfb-continuous-finite-etale-trace]. This step does not use P or M being locally free.

Apply [lem-sfb-continuous-finite-etale-trace-image-charts] to the given lattice pair and the normalized trace. On every cover member unpack its finite nonempty family of full lattices and its actual continuous-function presentation of the categorical image.

Apply [lem-sfb-continuous-lattice-sum-internal-free] to each chart, using 0<d to provide a nonempty sheet index. Restriction along the inverse canonical coefficient isomorphism identifies normalized module pullback freeness with the raw inverse-image predicate in LocallyFree. Keep this cover and the original epic trace.

proof_origin.place: Local computation: separate normalized rational trace and embedded integral image charts; complete the continuous-coordinate internal-freeness assembly in Lean.

theorem continuousFiniteEtaleTrace_lattice
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hP : LocallyFree (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X) P)
    {U : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ X) [IsFinite p] [Etale p] [Surjective p]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff l E) U))
    (hM : LocallyFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff l E) U) M)
    (e : (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap l E) U)).obj M ≅
      (upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj P) :
    ∃ τ : (lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj
        ((upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj P) ⟶ P,
      Epi τ ∧ LocallyFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff l E) X)
        (image (latticePushedEmbedding (integralScalarMap l E) X P p M e ≫
          (Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap l E) X)).map τ))
